paragraphs: Heathrow Airport Holdings seeks data‑driven insights to optimise operations; I have built end‑to‑end pipelines that turn raw data into actionable models, directly improving decision‑making.
I built scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client.
